title: 산업융합 촉진법 시행규칙 / queue:ADDENDUM:00001:20130323:00002:part:1/1
full_text:
Appendix (Rules for the Implementation of the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources and its Affiliated Institutions) <Item 1, March 23, 2013>

Article 1 (Effective Date) This rule shall take effect from the date of its promulgation. <Note: Omitted>

Articles 2 through 6 are omitted.

Article 7 (Amendments to Other Laws) Items ① through <22> are omitted.

<23> The following parts of the Rules for the Implementation of the Act on Promotion of Industrial Fusion are amended:

Item 2: All items except "Minister of Knowledge Economy Decree" shall be replaced with "Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources Decree."

Item 3, Paragraph 1: All items except "Minister of Knowledge Economy" shall be replaced with "Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources."

Item 3, Paragraph 2: "Minister of Knowledge Economy" shall be replaced with "Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources" in the same paragraph.

Forms 1 and 2 in Appendix shall be replaced with "Minister of Trade, Industry and Resources."

"Ministry of Knowledge Economy" in Form 1 shall be replaced with "Ministry of Trade, Industry and Resources."

<24> through <63> are omitted.
